Name: Powered Automation
Author: LuisMint
Description:
[size=4][b]About this mod[/b][/size]
Automate your farm without it feeling like cheating. This is a rework of the Automate mod that adds in game progression, more optimized automation (event-based), and new items and structures all themed around reclaimed dwarf technology.

After feeling a little unsatisfied with the Stardew automation mods currently out there, I decided to make this mod just for my farm; however, after multiple additions I've decided to release it publicly.
[line]
[b][size=4]Conduit Paths[/size][/b]
Unlike automate mod, powered automation only moves items via conduit paths that work like pipes. Touching containers and machines will no longer move items around, avoiding accidental interactions.. [i][color=#999999]like shipping out multiple chests[/color][/i]. The conduits are: 
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000]Input Conduit[/color][/b] [/*]
[*][b][color=#1e84cc]Output conduit[/color][/b][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][b]Omni conduit[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][img width=541]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786528565-1049201292.png[/img]
[img width=539]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786635368-984727330.gif[/img]
[color=#999999](item transfer animations can be disabled in config)[/color]

[b][size=4]Powered Chests[/size][/b]
All automation is based on the powered chests, a new chest type that works directly with conduit paths to move items to and from machines and or containers. The powered chest also powers adjacent tiles.

[img width=687]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786476387-442455594.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Power Grid[/size]
[/b]All automation can only run while "powered". The power grid limits the amount of "power coils" that can run at once. Power Coils give constant power within a limited radius (5x5). The default power grid capacity is 4 and can be expanded by building and submitting items to the Power Silo dwarf structure.

[size=4][b]Automation Delay
[/b][/size]Automation delay determines the amount of time (in real-time seconds) for each pull/push action on machines/containers. The default delay is 7 seconds and can be reduced by building and submitting items to the Automation Relay dwarf structure.

[size=4][b]Actions per Automation[/b][/size]
Actions per automation determines the amount of container/machine interactions can happen after each automation delay. the default actions per automation is 1 and can be increased by building and submitting items to the Automation Relay dwarf structure.

[size=4][b]Filters[/b][/size]
[img width=379]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786529241-952934673.png[/img]
Whitelist and Blacklist items via item, item amount, even by item category using new filter sign craftables. 
[list]
[*]Interact more than once while holding an item on a Whitelist/Blacklist sign to set an item amount - which can function as storage limits and overflow conditions for more complex item sorting. [/*]
[*]Interact more than once while holding an item on a Whitelist/Blacklist Category sign to see the "category" that item is a part of ([color=#999999]there are many weird and unnamed categories[/color])[/*]
[/list][img width=438]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1787988110-739778517.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Use Quality Tags on category signs to filter based on an item's quality, can also harvest aged wine earlier from casks using this type of sorting. Unlocked from a new special orders quest.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Auto Crafter[/size][/b]
[img width=374]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786634288-1443790606.gif[/img]
Automate the crafting of any known recipe (craftables, items, and even food). Not the most efficient, but as long as all ingredients are supplied, it will continue to craft on its own (filters can be used to set a cap on output, or only take from a set overflow).

[b][size=4]Power Required Machines[/size][/b]
[img width=136]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786538520-969817170.gif[/img]
Machines that can be a little too exploitable [i][color=#999999](...Crystalariums...)[/color][/i] now require being within power range to work. This can be configured in [font=Courier New][color=#1e84cc]Stardew Valley/Mods/PoweredAutomation/Automate/config.json[/color][/font][font=Arial], and can include any machine/s added by other mods.[/font]
[size=4]
[b]Cranked Power Coil[/b][/size]
An early game alternative to the power coil, it does not take up power grid capacity, but needs to be manually cranked to work for the day.
It can be learned after the landslide is cleared by Joja (day 5 onward) through a special cutscene entering the mountains.
(its functionality and balancing could possibly change in the future)
[img width=559]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1787652368-1258565260.gif[/img]
[line]
[b][size=4]Overlay[/size][/b]
Toggle the overlay view with 'U'(can be changed) to see valid automation groups, connected and unconnected containers/machines, as well as the tiles that are currently powered. The bottom left of the overlay shows the current power grid capacity, automation delay, and actions per automation.
[img width=553]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786471591-599025191.png[/img] 
[b]conduits in overlay:[/b]
[color=#ff7700]orange:[/color] output conduit
[color=#1e84cc]blue:[/color] input conduit
[color=#00ff00]green:[/color] omni conduit
[color=#980000]dark red / none:[/color] conduit not connected or powered

[b]machine and containers in overlay:[/b]
[color=#00ff00]green:[/color] connected to one valid conduit group
[color=#9900ff]purple:[/color]  connected to multiple valid conduit groups
[color=#980000]dark red:[/color] not connected to any conduit group, or part of an invalid group

[b]filter signs in overlay:[/b]
white square: valid whitelist filter
black square: valid blacklist filter
none: invalid filter

[b]power coils in overlay:[/b]
small green square: powered
small red square: unpowered
text shows number of power coils / total power grid capacity (example above: 9/9).
[line]
[b][size=4]Dwarf Technology?[/size][/b]
[img width=513]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786477117-909381542.gif[/img]
The new item recipes and structures can be purchased from the dwarf in the mines, cutting-edge discoveries made by other dwarfs apparently. The dwarf also sells "dwarf research notes" that seem to vaguely explain how powered automation works, but there also seems to be secrets scribbled onto these notes(?).
Every season the dwarf stocks one powered chest and power coil.
Every [u]Monday[/u] and [u]Tuesday[/u] the dwarf stocks a special mineral the farmer is already familiar with... could be useful.

[b]general story:[/b]
[spoiler][size=4][b]Powered Automation[/b][/size]
[font=Arial]Powered Automation is less about telling a story and more about introducing broader implications to Stardew Valley's world with 'reclaimed Dwarf technology'.

[b][size=4]History[/size][/b]
As established in the game, the Dwarfs descended from an incredibly advanced alien race that arrived on Earth long ago, crash landing somewhere deep beneath the planet's surface (at the very least, it can be theorized). They survived underground for assumedly multiple generations and even endured a war. But so much time had passed since then that much of their technology, history, and origins have been lost or forgotten, even to the Dwarfs themselves.
Vanilla Stardew Valley only includes 2 Dwarfs. Neither seem particularly interested in directly acknowledging or discussing the history of their kind or seem to fully understand where they truly come from. Powered Automation expands on the idea that they aren't the only ones of their kind around. Deep beneath the Valley, other Dwarfs exist in their own underground societies. Some have taken a renewed interest in the technology their ancestors once had and have begun recovering, restoring, and repurposing what was left behind.
The Dwarf in the mines is willing to sell this reclaimed technology and arrange Dwarf structure construction on the farmer's behalf, but despite this, they seem considerably more invested in the life they've already established in Stardew Valley. And for now the Dwarf in Ginger Island is completely alienated to reclaimed dwarf technology as a whole.

[size=4][b]Power[/b][/size]
The central power source of Powered Automation used by the player is the Power Coil. While the Coils are responsible for powering conduits and power-required machines, they aren't actually generating that power themselves.
Instead, they are drawing it from somewhere far below the Valley.
The Power Silo simply allows the farmer to draw a greater amount of this energy from underground at once. What that source of energy is exactly is never directly explained.
However, the implication is that this power source is actually Dwarven energy that has been leaking and radiating out from the original spacecraft that crash landed the dwarfs on Earth in the first place. Who knows how advanced, how large, or how much of the original ship is still intact, but for the dwarfs it has been unknowingly fueling their industrial renaissance.

[b][size=4]The Start[/size][/b]
I like to imagine that Powered Automation is just the rudimentary start to re-incarnating dwarf technology as it once was, and that one day the dwarfs may actually rediscover their full potential. But just like in Stardew, I don't think any of these questions will be answered.[/font][/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Example[/size][/b]

Using [u]Better Junimos[/u], this is a more complex setup that automatically processes crops and feeds seeds back into the hut. thanks to [u]More Junimo Chests[/u], there can be multiple storage networks that feed crops, seeds, fertilizer, and any other category of items from inside and out of the farm... In a Big Cave Hole (Dwarf structure) these crops are being processed and the excess goods are being sold through a mini shipping bin.
[img width=860]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786978724-1570057981.png[/img]
Using filter signs, the amount of items that are held and allowed through can be controlled; above only 1 raisin is allowed into the Junimo hut, as well as 20 fertilizer, and 20 seeds of each kind. There is some buffer that can be configured using these filters: at any moment there'll only be a max of 80 seeds of each at any given moment due to the seed filter being passed down multiple containers.
Since the Junimos are being fed both ancient fruit seeds and powdered melon seeds, this allows for year round automated farming.(besides giant crops getting in the way)
[img width=439]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50165/50165-1786977853-1192591049.png[/img]
this is just a quick example, but with more refining and complexity you can make many automation structures.
